units.source_text: 喝下去的水，原封不动地变成了汗，喷了出来。

en.t: The water he had swallowed turned straight into sweat and sprayed out.

units.source_text: 从肩胛骨到背脊，从锁骨到乳头的周围，从侧腹到腰骨的边缘，糜烂的皮肤，像剥掉一层薄皮似的疼痛。

en.t: From his shoulder blades to his spine, from his collarbones to the area around his nipples, from his flanks to the edges of his hip bones, the raw skin hurt as if a thin layer had been peeled away.
